mentions.name: Resettle
mentions.description: A native macOS app that restores your windows to their previous positions when you plug a monitor back in, automatically learning each of your display setups. Sold as a one-time $14.99 purchase.
mentions.problem: macOS dumps everything onto the laptop screen when a monitor is unplugged and never moves the windows back when it is reconnected.
mentions.source_excerpt: Resettle (https://getresettle.com), puts your mac windows back when you plug a monitor back in. macOS dumps everything on the laptop screen and never moves it back. it just learns each setup on its own. native swift, $14.99 once.
